summary: Invalid characters crash the game in jigsaw block input upon pressing enter
description: The bug Invalid characters crash the game in jigsaw block input upon pressing enter. How to reproduce - Execute the command: /give @s jigsaw - Open the jigsaw block (displaying the user interface) - Type in any of the text boxes, characters: or {} (invalid unicode characters blocking the "done" button) - Press the enter key The game crashes Crash report 1.14.3-pre3 : [^crash-2019-06-16_22.54.27-client.txt] Description: keyPressed event handler n: Non [a-z0-9/._-] character in path of location: minecraft:empty at qt. (SourceFile:38) at qt. (SourceFile:43) at dbo.d(SourceFile:44) at dbo.b(SourceFile:35) at dbo.keyPressed(SourceFile:106) at cvm.a(SourceFile:410) at cvm$$Lambda$3043/1332786777.run(Unknown Source) at czx.wrapScreenError(SourceFile:441) at cvm.a(SourceFile:408) at cvm$$Lambda$1477/601932288.invoke(Unknown Source) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFWKeyCallbackI.callback(GLFWKeyCallbackI.java:37) at org.lwjgl.system.JNI.invokeV(Native Method) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.glfwPollEvents(GLFW.java:3101) at cuh.l(SourceFile:425) at cuh.c(SourceFile:283) at cvo.b(SourceFile:1023) at cvo.e(SourceFile:976) at cvo.b(SourceFile:411) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:154)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Execute the command: `/give @s jigsaw`.
3. Open the jigsaw block to display the user interface.
4. In any of the text boxes, type invalid characters such as `:` or `{}`.
5. Press the enter key.
6. Observe that the game crashes.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.14.2, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 3, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 4, 1.14.3
Observed Behavior:
When attempting to use invalid characters (specifically `:` or `{}`) in the input fields of the jigsaw block user interface, pressing the Enter key results in a game crash. This occurs because the input validation does not properly handle these characters, which are not permitted within the expected format for jigsaw block paths. 

Upon pressing Enter after entering these invalid characters, the game generates a crash report indicating a failure in the keyPressed event handler. The error message specifically notes that a non-alphanumeric character was encountered in the path of the location, leading to an exception that causes the game to terminate unexpectedly. 

This bug is reproducible in Minecraft version 1.14.3-pre3 and has been consistently observed when following the steps outlined in the reproduction section. The crash report file generated during this incident is named `crash-2019-06-16_22.54.27-client.txt`, which contains the relevant stack trace and error details for further investigation by developers. 

To summarize, the game crashes when invalid characters are entered in the jigsaw block input fields, disrupting the player's ability to use this feature and resulting in an abrupt termination of the game client.
Expected Behavior: When entering valid characters in the jigsaw block interface and pressing the enter key, the game should accept the input without crashing. The user interface should allow for the input of various valid characters, enabling players to configure the jigsaw block correctly. Upon pressing enter, the changes should be saved, and the player should remain in the interface without any errors or crashes occurring.
